pages.text: Chapter 0 of Dao Guidance begins automatically for a new mortal. Use the Open Dao Guidance keybind to track it; the HUD and chapter page show the direction, distance, and X/Z coordinates of the nearest mountain cave.
The cave has two supply chests. One guarantees exactly one Enlightenment Pill; the other contains a Zhuji wandering cultivator kit. Taking the pill completes Chapter 0.

Consume an Enlightenment Pill and complete awakening and its separate selection screen to enter Qi Refining. The selection cannot be dismissed before completion.$(br2)Cultivation stats show realm, roots, health, Qi, lifespan, Thoughts, and cultivation progress.

$(br)Qi appears above the hunger bar. Mortals can still see the qi bar, but they do not naturally regenerate qi.$(br2)High ambient qi from nearby spirit-vein centers increases natural qi regeneration. Every 25 ambient qi makes it 25% faster.$(br2)Meditation requires standing on the ground and stops movement while active.

pages.title: Dao Guidance Side Lessons
pages.text: Open Dao Guidance to track practical objectives. Relevant items and systems reveal side lessons.$(br2)Use Understood to acknowledge explanations; practical objectives require real actions. Matching manual entries remain available as a reference.
